# `FactoryTestControl`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Outcome of a factory_test_control operation, sent immediately or from the deferred completion callback.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, factory_test_control handler @0xe1490, HandleDeleteUserImagesAsync @0x1423b0, HandleScopeHomeEvent @0x1438e0 (64-bit build) |

Custom producer. The factory_test_control handler builds the event and broadcasts it before appending its RPC reply (the reply is result 0 even when the operation failed). If the helper output contains the raw fragment "pending":true (scopePark, delUserImages), no immediate event is sent; the deferred callbacks (user-image deletion, ScopeHome completion) later send the same event name with operation, state and optional error/code. state is complete or fail; fail adds error and code (the TLS error, or 207; an unsupported operation string is reported as 102 here, not as an RPC error). Successful helpers can add record. Request metadata (userId, timestamp, platform, appVersion, osVersion) appear only inside record, not as top-level members. Channel I (TCP 4700). Delivery: ordinary broadcast to every retained socket of the emitting server (master, guest and never-verified sockets alike); no cadence, delivery or ordering guarantee relative to RPC replies or other events. APK 3.3.2 recognises it in the event-type dispatcher.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"FactoryTestControl"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `operation` | string | yes | - | The requested operation string, always inserted by the helper. Known operations: scopePark, delUserImages, delLicense, setLangEn, enterShippingMode (the event chapter names enterShippingMode, scopePark and delUserImages in the inspected producers). [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | complete on helper success, fail otherwise. One of: `complete`, `fail`. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if state is fail | - | Failure message. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if state is fail | - | Failure code (TLS error, or 207; 102 for an unsupported operation). [READ] |
| `record` | any | if some successful operations only | - | Saved metadata records on some successful operations: normally an array (FillRecord); enterShippingMode inserts a single object. Failure paths may lack it. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, complete-park - Deferred park completion (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"FactoryTestControl","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","operation":"scopePark","state":"complete"}
```

Event, fail-unknown-op - Unsupported operation (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"FactoryTestControl","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","operation":"example","state":"fail","error":"example error","code":102}
```

Event, complete-with-record - Success with records (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"FactoryTestControl","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","operation":"setLangEn","state":"complete","record":[{"userId":"example-user","platform":"android","appVersion":"3.3.2"}]}
```
